summary: Iteration 49 (Customer Commerce Platform v29) — 20/24 backend tests pass. 3 real bugs found: (1) VOUCHER PARTIAL-REDEEM BLOCKED after first partial — POST /api/vouchers with {partialRedeemable:true, usageType:'one_time'} defaults maxRedemptions=1, so the 2nd partial redemption returns 400 'Voucher has reached max redemptions' instead of allowing subsequent partials until residualValue<=0. This also breaks the duplicate-transaction guard (returns 400 max-reached instead of 409 dupe) because rules check runs BEFORE dupe check. (2) LEGACY /api/transactions returns 500 (pre-existing? — pydantic ValidationError because get_transactions omits {'_id':0} projection at routes/transactions.py:72 so ObjectId leaks into Transaction model). This blocks the Accounting page (Failed to load data toast) and therefore the RefundDialog cannot be reached from UI. (3) LEGACY /api/gift-cards returns 500 (pydantic ValidationError: GiftCard model requires balance/initialValue which existing docs lack — routes/transactions.py:179). All new v29 endpoints (wallet, timeline, refunds/flexible, ai/promotion-goal, loyalty/status, personalisation, gift-cards/schedule+reload, promo-analytics/summary, voucher bulk/list/lookup/validate/revoke) work correctly and match spec. Frontend: /vouchers page fully renders (vouchers-page, analytics-strip w/ 5 cards, voucher-rows table, Issue voucher button, voucher-create-dialog opens, tab-ai-builder present). Customer profile embeds CustomerWalletPanel with all 6 buckets, wallet-tier, loyalty-progress, milestones-strip, and Vouchers/Journey/AI-recs tabs. Cosmetic issues on customer profile: (a) 'undefined%' text at the bottom of the voucher list in wallet panel — template rendering bug; (b) wallet-streak testid not rendered when streakWeeks=0 (should still be present as '0-week streak' or hidden gracefully); (c) Sarah Johnson has 89 recorded visits + $2515 spent per customer card but loyalty/status only counts 3 visits/$68.13 because it filters transactions.status IN ('completed','paid','closed') and seeded transactions likely use different status values — this makes the Bronze/Silver progress bar misleading.

critical.issue: Partial-redeemable voucher with default maxRedemptions=1 rejects 2nd partial redemption with 400 'max redemptions'. Duplicate-transactionId guard (409) is also unreachable because _validate_voucher_rules runs first and returns 400 for max-reached. Fix: either default maxRedemptions=None when partialRedeemable=True in _issue_voucher, OR skip the maxRedemptions check inside _validate_voucher_rules when partialRedeemable and residualValue>0, AND move the duplicate-tx guard to BEFORE _validate_voucher_rules in redeem_voucher().

Returns 500 (pydantic ValidationError) because routes/transactions.py:72 uses db.transactions.find(query) without {'_id':0} projection — ObjectId leaks into Transaction model. Breaks Accounting page ('Failed to load data' toast) and prevents opening the new RefundDialog from UI.

Returns 500 (pydantic ValidationError: GiftCard.balance / initialValue Field required). Legacy gift_cards collection docs in DB lack these fields; either use safe_parse_list, add default=0.0 in models/gift_card.py, or filter defensively.

ui_bugs.issue: 'undefined%' text appears at the bottom of the voucher list — a template variable is unresolved (screenshot: /app/.screenshots/customer_wallet.png).
wallet-streak data-testid is not rendered when streakWeeks=0. Spec required 'streak badge' as one of the top-line elements.

integration_issues.issue: Accounting page cannot load transactions (GET /api/transactions 500), so the new RefundDialog cannot be opened from UI. Unable to click Issue Refund → could not verify add-split-card / add-split-store_credit / add-split-points / add-split-voucher, refund-submit against /api/refunds/flexible from the browser. Backend endpoint itself works (validated via pytest with 2 splits, ledger writes correct).

issues: Tier badge shows 'Bronze' with 'Next tier: Silver $68/$500' — inconsistent with the profile header stats card ($2515 total spent / 89 visits). Root cause: loyalty/status filters transactions.status IN ('completed','paid','closed') but seeded transactions likely use 'complete' or another status. Recommend broadening the filter or aligning seeded status values.

action_items: FIX in routes/commerce_v29.py: In _issue_voucher, if partialRedeemable=True and maxRedemptions not explicitly set (=1 default), set maxRedemptions=None. Alternatively, in _validate_voucher_rules, skip maxRedemptions check when partialRedeemable and residualValue>0.
FIX in routes/commerce_v29.py::redeem_voucher: move the duplicate-transactionId guard BEFORE _validate_voucher_rules() call so 409 is returned instead of 400 on retry.

FIX in routes/transactions.py:72: add {'_id': 0} projection to db.transactions.find(query) so GET /api/transactions works (currently 500 — blocks Accounting UI and therefore the whole RefundDialog UI test surface).
FIX in routes/transactions.py:179: use utils.mongo_safe.safe_parse_list or make GiftCard.balance/initialValue Optional with default 0.0 — GET /api/gift-cards currently 500s.

FIX in CustomerWalletPanel.jsx: 'undefined%' template render at the bottom of the voucher list — check the .map that renders voucher rows for a variable that is not always defined (probably progress % on a redeemed/no-progress row).
FIX in CustomerWalletPanel.jsx: render wallet-streak testid even when streakWeeks=0 (e.g. '0-week streak' or an empty badge), so downstream tests can locate it.

REVIEW loyalty/status filter — align transactions.status values used across seeds & queries (currently seeds appear to use a status not in ('completed','paid','closed'), so Sarah Johnson looks like a 3-visit / $68 customer despite the customer profile card showing 89 visits / $2515).
critical_code_review_comments: commerce_v29.py (998 lines): file is large; consider splitting into voucher.py / wallet.py / refund.py / loyalty.py / personalisation.py / gift_cards.py under a /commerce package. Right now it is doing 8 discrete responsibilities in one file.
commerce_v29.py::_validate_voucher_rules: check-ordering matters. Duplicate-transactionId guard needs to run FIRST (idempotency), THEN status/expiry, THEN rules. Current order fails the spec.

commerce_v29.py::_issue_voucher: VoucherCreate default maxRedemptions=1 is a footgun for partialRedeemable / multi_use / unlimited vouchers. Recommend: if usageType='multi_use' or partialRedeemable=True and caller did not pass maxRedemptions, set to None.
commerce_v29.py::promo_analytics: does N+1 DB query for each redemption to fetch transaction totals. For hot analytics endpoint, batch txn.find({'id': {'$in': tx_ids}}) once and reduce.

commerce_v29.py::wallet_timeline: correctly excludes _id via projection and merges 6 collections. lifetimeValue sums only 'order' events — will only be correct if txn.total field is populated (Sarah shows totalOrders=0 despite 3 transactions with total>0 because filter path uses meta.total which is nested dict — verify).

voucher.py model: default maxRedemptions=1 is applied at Voucher() construction as well as VoucherCreate — even setting it to None in _issue_voucher may be silently coerced back to 1 depending on caller. Add explicit override in _issue_voucher.

wallet_ledger.py: LedgerEntry has 'balanceAfter' snapshot but _ledger_write pulls previous entries as full list every write — O(n) per write. Consider using a summary doc per (customerId,type) or an aggregation pipeline for balance.

routes/transactions.py: dual-registration of /gift-cards across three files (transactions.py, v25_suite.py at /v25, v26_commerce.py) — the transactions.py version is the one that wins on /api/gift-cards and it is broken. Choose one owner for this route.

rca of the issue: PARTIAL-REDEEM BUG RCA: VoucherCreate model in models/voucher.py:112 has 'maxRedemptions: Optional[int] = 1'. When the client posts {partialRedeemable:true, usageType:'one_time'} without explicit maxRedemptions, the default 1 is stamped on the Voucher. The first partial redemption sets redemptionCount=1, status='partial', residualValue=15. When the caller tries a 2nd partial with a new transactionId, _validate_voucher_rules() at line 235 checks 'if v.get(maxRedemptions) and v.get(redemptionCount, 0) >= v[maxRedemptions]' — 1 >= 1 is True → returns 'Voucher has reached max redemptions' (400), aborting redemption. THE STATUS-TRANSITION LOGIC AT LINE 328-336 IS CORRECT but is never reached because validation blocks first. Fix: in _issue_voucher(), when the incoming payload has partialRedeemable=True and did not explicitly specify maxRedemptions (or specified None), set the field to None on the stored voucher. Alternatively, in _validate_voucher_rules, guard: 'if not v.get(partialRedeemable) and v.get(maxRedemptions) and v.get(redemptionCount, 0) >= v[maxRedemptions]'. DUP-GUARD 409 RCA: Line 291 calls _validate_voucher_rules (returns 400), only THEN checks 'if body.transactionId and any(r.transactionId == body.transactionId ...)' (409). For a same-txn retry on a 1-partial-consumed voucher, the max-redemptions check fires first, so 409 is never emitted. Fix: swap the two checks so duplicate-tx returns 409 before generic validation.
